items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Big Kato and Brad. That's his cousin. [INTERVIEWEE] Cousin.

ctx.x: Then on piano we had Kato, John Porter. What's one of the Kato's? Little Kato or Big Kato? Little Kato. You know Little Kato.
Yeah, Big Kato and Brad. That's his cousin.
